model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect values for different language families, as determined by various models. The horizontal axis displays language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Slavic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-other family, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, ordered from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Error bars are displayed for each bar, indicating variability extending above and below the bar's peak. There are four groups of bars representing different models: mBERT-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, and XLM-B2, each represented by a distinct color—green, red, blue, and teal, respectively—as indicated in the legend. For example, the mBERT-L2 bars (green) show values ranging approximately from -8 to 4; the XLM-B2 bars (teal) show values ranging from approximately -10 to 2. The bars within each model group are positioned alongside each other for each language family, allowing for a visual comparison of the effect values across the models for each family. Some bars display visual emphasis through shading.
